messages:
Ivy: quick postmortem follow-up 1: summarized recurring paging clusters and sketched a minimal plan to reduce noise without hiding real incidents. attaching heatmap link: https://internal.redwood/notes/noise-heatmap :map:
Marcus: nice summary. what are the immediate surgical changes we can do this week?
Ivy: three low-risk items: 1) add 3m dedupe window for kvcache with group_by=request_prefix, 2) change auth-db alert to use 99th pctl with 3m hysteresis, 3) implement a soft (non-pager) alert for model-serving OOM spikes for 48h to capture context.
Hannah: I'll take the kvcache dedupe canary. plan: push canary config to canary-hosts, run synthetic churn, monitor suppression_rate and missed_alert_estimate. ETA canary results tomorrow morning.
Marcus: I'll handle auth-db thresholds. will coordinate with db infra for safe threshold ranges and add a runbook note about rollback. ETA Fri.
Ivy: good. For dedupe safety: add an "allow_urgent_if" gate so we never suppress when error_rate > 0.2. Also add a dashboard tile with suppression_rate and estimated missed alerts.
Hannah: sample canary snippet I tested:
```
policy: dedupe-kvcache-v1
group_by: request_prefix
window: 180s
max_pages: 1
allow_urgent_if: error_rate > 0.2
```
Hannah: will push and report initial metrics in thread.
alert-bot: Created INF-5065 "kvcache dedupe canary" assigned to Hannah, due 2026-04-07.
Marcus: paging policy tweak suggestion: Critical -> 2 pings then escalate after 5m; High -> single page then suppress duplicates for 20m; include service-owner notification on suppression.
Ivy: please include explicit rollback criteria: "if missed_alert_estimate >= 0.005 for 30m -> rollback and page infra-oncall". add to the runbook.
Hannah: timeline recap: Hannah (kvcache canary) results by tomorrow AM; Marcus (auth thresholds + runbook) by Fri; Ivy (dashboards + action tracker) by EOD today. weekly follow-up: Thu 11:00 20m.
Marcus: small process ask 1: add a recurring 15m "noise triage" after weekly oncall handoff to check for drift. Ivy can you schedule?
Ivy: scheduled: "Noise Triage" Thu 11:30 15m, invite sent. updated action sheet with owners, links, and rollback steps. will post canary link when Hannah shares results. :white_check_mark:
